acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Append a case with a frozen inventory of three references to the same frozen observation. Its status accessor returns primitive passed, primitive failed and undefined on successive reads. One summarize call yields exactly {total:3, passed:1, failed:1, unavailable:1}; a read counter and ordered trace prove exactly three occurrence-ordered reads.

Append an equivalent case with the same Proxy instance repeated three times in a frozen inventory. A frozen accessor-backed target can supply changing statuses without violating Proxy invariants. Assert the same exact counters and three ordered status reads; do not use a frozen non-writable status data property with changing trap results.

For both cases, capture descriptors and reference identities without evaluating status. After summarization assert inventory length/order, repeated reference identity, frozen state, unchanged descriptors, nested object/array identities and nested contents. Assertions must not read status; reassert the read counter and trace after all preservation assertions.

The eventual diff changes only src/summary.test.mjs and this issue's OpenSpec plan, preserving provider metadata, all existing function bodies/exports, every existing assertion and all 26 tests. No accepted model, prior plan, tooling, workflow/check policy or customization changes.

During authorized implementation, all five issue-specific independent commands pass against the candidate, with all 28 tests passing and provider citation validation retained. Publish one native implementation PR through the separate publisher; integration requires separate owner approval of its exact head.
